content.context: Audited memory-dashboard via skill-router (code-review, vercel-react-best-practices, codebase-design). Implemented P0 mutation auth guard lib/request-guard.ts with PITMRY_TOKEN on automations/skills/logs/notifications/onboarding POST-PUT-DELETE; bound dev/start to localhost; clamped limit params; dynamic-imported GalaxyView and KnowledgeGraph to split three.js off first load; made feed/palette/graph/galaxy fetches abortable; deferred filter query with useDeferredValue; full Three.js GPU disposal on unmount; shared MemoryItem types; formatDate accepts ISO strings; server.log rotation. Committed 6c6e575, pushed to GitLab origin and new GitHub pitmhz/pitmry remote.
content.decision: PITMRY_TOKEN optional-token pattern: open when unset for local dev, enforced when set; GET stays read-open
content.rationale: Unauthenticated mutation routes plus LAN-bound Next server was the highest risk; localhost bind plus token guard closes it with zero UX cost. three.js static import was the largest first-load cost so dynamic import first. Fetch races caused stale feed states so AbortController per effect. Deferred filter keeps typing responsive on large feeds.

summary: PITMRY_TOKEN optional-token pattern: open when unset for local dev, enforced when set; GET stays read-open
